require 'securerandom'

class RequestId
  HEADER = 'X-Request-Id'

  def initialize(app)
    @app = app
  end

  def call(env)
    request_id = env['HTTP_X_REQUEST_ID'] || SecureRandom.uuid
    status, headers, body = @app.call(env)
    headers[HEADER] = request_id
    [status, headers, body]
  end
end
